title: Tailscale Variables
description: Tailscale group: connectivity flags and tailnet coordinates. Variable names are camelCase and prefixed with the group token 'tailscale'.

tailscaleOperations.description: Ordered, non-empty list of Tailscale operations to run. Supply at ansible-playbook runtime with -e; valid operations are diagnose, down, install, status, uninstall, up, and update.

tailscaleSSH.description: Set true to enable Tailscale SSH (the --ssh flag) for this host.

tailscaleVersion.description: Optional Tailscale version 1.36.0 or newer for a Debian-family Linux update. Omit for latest; pinned versions are unsupported on macOS.
